faqs.q: How do I cancel or modify a booking?
faqs.a: Open the booking from My Bookings, then use Cancel or Modify reservation. Pending and confirmed bookings can be changed.

faqs.q: How do I check in at the hotel?
faqs.a: Show the QR code on your booking detail screen at the front desk — it encodes your booking code for a quick check-in.
Bookings are paid securely through VNPay at checkout. We don't store your card details.

faqs.q: How do I get a refund?
faqs.a: Cancellations follow each hotel's policy. Contact us below if you need help with a refund.
